text:
maria: Quick heads-up — ran a host-side perf profile after last night's kernel-selector rollout. Seeing a spike in CPU from tokenization + parse paths around 02:15 UTC. flamegraph: https://perf.internal/redwood/1732468012.svg

jon: Can you paste the top stacks? wondering if this is kernel or batching related.

maria: Sure — top 5 stacks (samples):
```
20%  tokenization::utf8_normalize
15%  request::parse_headers
12%  grpc::writev_smallwrites
10%  kvcache::lookup_miss_path
8%   kernel_selector::pick_kernels_for_len
```
Context: rollout toggled `kernel-autoselect=v2` at 01:50 UTC, small canary (5%).

alex: We shipped that selector PR (RFC#438) yesterday — it biases for fused attention kernels when seq_len>512. Might change CPU distribution in host preproc (we saw similar in local perf). PR: https://repo/pull/438

lee: Measured tail latency on canary vs baseline quickly: p50 tokens/ms baseline=1.2 -> canary=1.25, p95 baseline=2.8 -> canary=3.6. Small but visible.

pranav: kvcache metrics look noisy. Miss rate jumped ~3x for short-prefix keys during the same window. Suspect different serialization ordering from the new kernel path causing key mismatch. iostat + kvcache logs:
```
kvcache.misses_per_min: 312 -> 978
kvcache.evictions: 42 -> 190
```

maria: here's a short log snippet where we see the mismatch:
```
[01:58:12] req_id=abc tokenized=tok_v1 hash=0x7f3 -> stored
[01:58:12] req_id=abc tokenized=tok_v2 hash=0x9b1 -> lookup miss
```
Not definitive but lines up with selector changing token framing boundary.

zara: Also noticed increased small gRPC writes on the same hosts after streaming-chunking tweak last week. Smallwrites amplify CPU. Dump from tcpstats: `writev_count_small=+18%`

deploy-bot: deploy "kernel-autoselect=v2" -> canary(5%) completed 2024-11-03T01:50:00Z :rocket:

jon: Two actionable hypotheses: 1) kernel selector changes token frame boundaries (causing kvcache key churn), 2) selector's fused kernels change batching profile -> more small writes.

alex: Agree. We should triage quickly because this affects p95. Options: revert selector in canary, or patch tokenizer to normalize framing invariant before kvcache insert.

maria: Proposed quick mitigation: patch tokenizer to always emit stable prefix-hash (normalizing whitespace/utf8) and increase tokenizer-pool GC to reduce intermediate allocations. I can ship a hotfix to canary hosts today.

pranav: I'll add a kvcache compatibility test that asserts key stability across kernel flags. Will run it against PRs.

lee: If we revert, we should still run the compatibility test to avoid flip-flop.

alex: I'll run an A/B with revert on 5% -> 0% and the tokenizer hotfix on another 5% to compare. Schedule in 30m?

maria: sounds good. I'll open the hotfix PR and include the flamegraph and logs in the PR description.

jon: Thanks — tag me and @zara. If hotfix looks clean, we can promote. :thumbsup:

zara: will watch grpc metrics and smallwrite counters.

maria: PR: https://repo/pull/456 (hotfix + test) — rolling to canary now.

deploy-bot: rollback plan for kernel-autoselect=v2 created (ops-ticket #8921).

jon: Nice runbook. Keep updates here with numbers after 10m and 30m.

maria: 10m in: kvcache.misses_per_min down to 260, writev_small -3%, p95 lat improved ~12%. Posting more after 30m.

alex: great, thanks everyone.

maria: 30m in: stable. will mark as incident mitigated and follow up with postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
